descriptionText: 1989 Topps Tony Gwynn #570 trading card featuring Tony Gwynn from the San Diego Padres in the Major League (MLB). This sports trading card is part of the 1989 Topps set produced by Topps. The card showcases Gwynn, a legendary baseball player, and is a collectible item for fans and collectors.
